{"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["pydantic_cli/examples/simple_with_custom.py:15:config-class"], "search": "    input_file: str = Field(..., cli=("-i", "--input"))
    max_records: int = Field(10, cli=("-m", "--max-records"))
    min_filter_score: float = Field(..., cli=("-f", "--filter-score"))", "replace": "    input_file: str = Field(..., json_schema_extra={"cli": ("-i", "--input")})
    max_records: int = Field(10, json_schema_extra={"cli": ("-m", "--max-records")})
    min_filter_score: float = Field(..., json_schema_extra={"cli": ("-f", "--filter-score")})", "explanation": "The failure is caused by passing non-standard `cli=` keyword arguments to `Field`. In Pydantic V2 extra kwargs to Field are deprecated (PydanticDeprecatedSince20) and must be moved into `json_schema_extra`, per the V2 migration guide. The values are unchanged, only the carrier changed. The `class Config` finding is already resolved by the existing `model_config = ConfigDict(...)` in the current content, so no edit was needed for it."}], "notes": "The collection failure comes from three `Field(..., cli=...)` / `Field(10, cli=...)` calls on Options (input_file, max_records, min_filter_score). They are moved to `json_schema_extra={"cli": ...}` in one contiguous edit, and the tuple values are kept as-is. The class-Config finding (line 15) is already fixed in the current content: `model_config = ConfigDict(**{...})` replaces the class Config, so I left that block untouched, as well as the existing imports, which are all still used. Caveat: pydantic_cli/core.py (not part of this edit) must read the "cli" option from `field_info.json_schema_extra` rather than `field_info.extra`, or the CLI flags will silently stop being registered. That file is being migrated separately and needs to be checked against this change."}
